nodes.label: Role-based access control (dono/editor/leitor)
nodes.rationale: Three roles enforced: dono (owner/admin), editor, leitor (read-only). Dono is hardcoded as tipinheiro@ufma.br as fallback. UI elements shown/hidden based on role.

nodes.label: Lazy Loading via FullCalendar events callback
nodes.rationale: FullCalendar fetches only the visible date range from Supabase on demand, avoiding loading all ~400 records at once. Replaces the previous carregarDadosDaNuvem approach.
nodes.norm_label: lazy loading via fullcalendar events callback

nodes.label: Supabase Realtime postgres_changes subscription
nodes.rationale: Listens to INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on reservas table to keep calendar in sync across clients without polling.
